name: Gessho-ji Temple
description: Gessho-ji is the family temple of the Matsudaira clan, lords of Matsue Domain, where nine generations of daimyo are buried in large stone-terraced compounds. Established in the 17th century, the Jodo-sect temple takes its name from Gessho-in, mother of the first lord Matsudaira Naomasa. The grounds hold ornate mausoleum gates, stone lanterns and the famous Great Turtle of Gessho-ji described by Lafcadio Hearn.
highlights: The Great Turtle from Hearn's essays
notes: Verified hours/fees from official site. Adult ¥700; ¥600 groups 30+. Cash-only admission.

ja.name: 月照寺
ja.description: 月照寺は、松江藩を治めた松平家の菩提寺で、歴代藩主9人の墓所が石段の上に整えられています。初代藩主松平直政の母・月照院にちなんで名付けられた浄土宗の寺院です。境内には精巧な廟門や石灯籠が立ち並び、ラフカディオ・ハーンの随筆にも登場する「月照寺の大亀」があります。
highlights: 松平家歴代藩主9人の廟所
